---
title: "Import data from Google Drive"
output: html_document
---

## Load packages

```{r packages}
# install.packages(c("googledrive", "httpuv", "readr", "readxl"))
library(googledrive)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
```

## Authorize googledrive

Each person runs this with their own Gmail. The first time, it opens a browser,
and you must check the box that gives access to your Drive files. Run it once
in the console before you knit.

```{r auth}
googledrive::drive_auth(
  email = gargle::gargle_oauth_email(),
  path = NULL,
  scopes = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive",
  cache = gargle::gargle_oauth_cache(),
  use_oob = gargle::gargle_oob_default(),
  token = NULL)
```

## Find the files on the Drive

```{r find-files}
drive_url <- googledrive::as_id("https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1IFOJOUNOeNzQ35feaRyhcOSVgZCa6odZ")

drive_folder <- googledrive::drive_ls(path = drive_url)
drive_folder

# recursive = TRUE also looks inside subfolders
csv_files  <- googledrive::drive_ls(path = drive_url, recursive = TRUE, pattern = "\\.csv$")
xlsx_files <- googledrive::drive_ls(path = drive_url, recursive = TRUE, pattern = "\\.xlsx$")
zip_files  <- googledrive::drive_ls(path = drive_url, recursive = TRUE, pattern = "\\.zip$")

csv_files
xlsx_files
zip_files
```

## Download new or updated files

Files are saved in the `input` folder in the project directory. A file is only
downloaded if it isn't in `input` yet, or if it was changed on the Drive after
your local copy was downloaded.

```{r download}
input_dir <- "input"
dir.create(input_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Downloads one file if it is missing or out of date; returns the local path
download_if_new <- function(drive_files, i){
  local_path    <- file.path(input_dir, drive_files$name[i])
  drive_changed <- as.POSIXct(drive_files$drive_resource[[i]]$modifiedTime,
                              format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC")

  if(!file.exists(local_path) || file.mtime(local_path) < drive_changed){
    googledrive::drive_download(file = drive_files$id[i], path = local_path, overwrite = T)
  } else {
    message("Up to date, skipping: ", drive_files$name[i])
  }
  local_path
}
```

## Read the files into R
Cross-references with date on google drive items and only replaces/redownloads if there has been an update to the file, or if there is a new item added
```{r read-files}
data_list <- list()

# CSVs
for(i in seq_len(nrow(csv_files))){
  local_path <- download_if_new(csv_files, i)
  data_list[[csv_files$name[i]]] <- readr::read_csv(local_path)
}

# Excel files (reads the first sheet)
for(i in seq_len(nrow(xlsx_files))){
  local_path <- download_if_new(xlsx_files, i)
  data_list[[xlsx_files$name[i]]] <- readxl::read_excel(local_path)
}

# Zip files: only the CSVs inside are kept, in input/<zip name>/
# The zip itself goes to a temporary file and is deleted after unzipping
for(i in seq_len(nrow(zip_files))){
  zip_dir       <- file.path(input_dir, sub("\\.zip$", "", zip_files$name[i]))
  drive_changed <- as.POSIXct(zip_files$drive_resource[[i]]$modifiedTime,
                              format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC")
  local_csvs    <- list.files(zip_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

  # Download and unzip only if the CSVs are missing or older than the zip on the Drive
  if(length(local_csvs) == 0 || min(file.mtime(local_csvs)) < drive_changed){
    temp_zip <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
    googledrive::drive_download(file = zip_files$id[i], path = temp_zip, overwrite = T)

    csvs_in_zip <- grep("\\.csv$", unzip(temp_zip, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE)
    csvs_in_zip <- csvs_in_zip[!grepl("__MACOSX", csvs_in_zip)] #zips were created on a mac, this line of code deals with naming structure related to that
    dir.create(zip_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
    unzip(temp_zip, files = csvs_in_zip, exdir = zip_dir, junkpaths = TRUE)
    unlink(temp_zip)

    local_csvs <- list.files(zip_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  } else {
    message("Up to date, skipping: ", zip_files$name[i])
  }

  for(focal_file in local_csvs){
    data_list[[basename(focal_file)]] <- readr::read_csv(focal_file)
  }
}
```

## Check what was imported

```{r check}
names(data_list)
```
